tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: The locked paper colour. Fixed in both themes; use when you need the literal brand paper (e.g. a paper card sliding over talking-head footage).

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: The locked ink colour. Fixed in both themes; the literal brand ink.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The locked signal red. ONE use per frame: the key phrase, the key number, or a pen mark. Text in signal only at 60px and above (contrast vs paper is about 3.7:1, large-text only).

tokens.name: signal-deep
tokens.usage: The deep step of signal red (5.7:1 on paper). Highlight level 3, The point: a solid bar with paper text, max one per frame. Also any red text below 60px. Headline phrases and pen marks stay in the brighter signal.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Frame background. Paper theme is the default; ink theme for heavier moments and variety.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised cards, chart panels, chat bubbles on bg. Never a third colour, only a step of the ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and solid shapes on bg or surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg: sources, dates, labels, axis text. At least 4.5:1 on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Grid hairlines and construction lines. Structure you feel more than see.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Rules, dividers, diagram connectors, chart axes.

tokens.name: highlight-follow
tokens.usage: Highlight level 1, Follow: a pale wash that tracks the words being read out (ReadAlong, PostCard). Text stays ink. Never more than one sentence lit at a time.

tokens.name: signal-marker
tokens.usage: Highlight level 2, Key line: a stronger wash behind the sentence that matters, text stays ink. Also the fill of tags (Callout, coordinate tags). See Highlights in Pen and grid.

tokens.name: ink-ghost
tokens.usage: Text that hasn't been spoken yet in KaraokeText, and placeholder rows. Decorative only: never for text that must be read on its own.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Ink fade behind text that sits directly on footage (TitleOverFace, BeatWord) and the dimming over an EchoBackdrop's echo. Always as a short fade or overlay, never a flat box.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hook titles: one short line, 3-6 words. Sizes are at the native 1080px-wide canvas.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Carousel slide headlines and in-video key lines.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers in StatReveal, RadarSweep readouts and slider values. Unit beside it in headline style or a serif unit (concept-title) on explainer plates.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Diagram nodes, chart titles, lower-third names. Bricolage Bold.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Body text stays short: one idea per line.
styles.usage: Supporting text. The smallest size for anything meant to be read in a reel.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Numbered labels, axis labels, tags. Floor size: nothing smaller than 32px on a 1080 canvas.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Source lines and fine print, in ink-muted.

styles.name: caption-pill
styles.usage: Burned-in captions (Captions). 1-3 words, in an ink pill.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a ConceptTitle or explainer plate, between two short hairlines. Also TabLabel text at 0.12em.

styles.name: accent-italic
styles.usage: The signature phrase: one key phrase inside a headline, in signal red, same Bricolage face, upright. Never a whole line; 60px and above. (Name kept for compatibility; it is no longer italic.)

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Quotes from people, companies, courts. Gambetta regular, ink.

styles.name: stat-serif
styles.usage: Alternative StatReveal number in Gambetta, for money and documentary-style figures.

styles.name: concept-title
styles.usage: Gambetta title of an explainer plate (ConceptTitle). Optional second line in italic. Never the reel's hook.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to text, number to unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to value, line to line in a block.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid gutter; gap between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Side margin of every frame; gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large separation; diagram node spacing.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room around a single hook or number.

tokens.name: safe-top
tokens.usage: Reels: keep text below this (username and audio row sit above).

tokens.name: safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Reels: keep text above this (caption, buttons and progress bar sit below).

tokens.name: safe-right
tokens.usage: Reels: keep text left of this from the right edge (like, comment, share column).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. Frames, cards, chart bars, diagram nodes: square and editorial.

tokens.name: radius-highlight
tokens.usage: The very subtle rounded ends on highlight bars at 1080px. Only highlights; tags and frames stay square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tags and pills only.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles and phone/app screenshots, so they read as UI, not as brand shapes.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Grid lines and construction lines (with line).

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Rules, connectors, chart axes (with line-strong or ink).

tokens.name: stroke-pen
tokens.usage: Hand-drawn pen marks in signal: underline, circle, arrow, strike, tick.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only for floating UI objects on paper: PromptBox, PostCard, WindowFrame. Never on brand shapes.

easing.note: Motion curves. Pick by what the element is, not by taste per reel: text Soft, cards and frames Smooth, tags and ticks Settle, lines Draw, camera Cinematic, anything leaving Exit. See the Motion section.

tokens.name: ease-soft
tokens.usage: Text arriving: headlines, hook words, labels, quotes, numbers. Starts gently, settles long.

tokens.name: ease-smooth
tokens.usage: Cards, frames, windows, diagram nodes, chart bars, and anything relocating (slider handle, spans). Even ease in and out.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Small accents only: tags, ticks, pins, icons, role chips. A tiny overshoot, then rest. Never on text, cards or frames.

tokens.name: ease-draw
tokens.usage: Lines, leaders, connectors, rules, pen marks, highlight sweeps. Gentle start like a hand, long finish.

tokens.name: ease-cinematic
tokens.usage: Camera push and pan on a graphic, map zooms, big reveal moments. Slow build, slow landing.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Anything leaving inside a scene. Eases in and accelerates away.

tokens.name: ease-snap
tokens.usage: The old default. Instant start, hard stop. Only for a deliberate hit, like a word slamming in on a beat. Not a default.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Only for motion that follows the voice or time: typing, karaoke sweeps, read-along bars, count-up last digits, the radar sweep, slow push-ins.

duration.note: Speed tiers. To make a whole reel calmer or punchier, move every element one tier up or down rather than retuning each one.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Colour changes on the voice: karaoke words, ghost to ink, focus swaps.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Small accents (tags, ticks, pins, icons) and exits.

tokens.name: dur-normal
tokens.usage: Default arrival for text and cards. Lines and pen marks.

tokens.name: dur-relaxed
tokens.usage: Big titles, full frames and windows, chart bars growing.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Reveals, scan wipes, elements travelling across the frame, count-ups.

tokens.name: dur-camera
tokens.usage: Camera push or pan on a graphic and map zooms (1.2 to 2s range).
